claim_boundary: Fresh paired MuJoCo M8 evidence only. The Jin-style arm is a frozen engineering proxy, not a faithful paper reproduction. Because the M8 geometry, labels, data distribution, and controller differ, these numbers cannot be compared directly with the paper's reported 97.4% square classification accuracy. No hardware or universal superiority claim is licensed.

derived_rebuild.reason: Corrected the derived strict-48 operational direction summary to use the actually executed RunResult.control_direction_deg rather than the ensemble-top-class RunResult.direction_error_deg; rebuilt CSVs/report/summary/figure/manifest from unchanged frozen evidence.

direction_layer.evaluation_role: Fresh structured P1v6 radial/sector direction stress; separate from the strict-48 operational task distribution.

paired_base_pose_cluster_bootstrap.cluster_unit: base_pose_id = state/radius/local-angle/physical-sector; all nuisance repeats remain together
paired_base_pose_cluster_bootstrap.estimand: median over paired scans of abs_error_improved_deg - abs_error_jin_proxy_deg
paired_base_pose_cluster_bootstrap.implementation_note: The cluster interval was preregistered; deterministic seed and resample count were fixed during the post-run consistency repair.
paired_base_pose_cluster_bootstrap.interval_interpretation: The 95% interval includes zero; this paired-median P1v6 contrast does not establish a direction-error advantage.
paired_base_pose_cluster_bootstrap.method: paired base-pose cluster bootstrap, percentile interval

direction_layer.result_characterization: mixed: improved has lower median and better within-15 rate, while the proxy has better p90, within-7.5, >90 tail, and common 12-sector accuracy; the paired base-pose cluster-bootstrap interval for the median absolute-error difference includes zero

interpretation_rule: Report the measured paired differences and exact McNemar p-values. For strict-48 direction, use the executed control_direction_deg rather than the ensemble top class. Do not infer superiority merely from a higher point estimate.

improved_fingerprint.executed_control_direction_definition: circular absolute error between frozen RunResult.control_direction_deg (the direction actually executed by direct-first) and RunResult.true_direction_deg

top_class_direction_diagnostic.role: diagnostic only; this is not the direct-first ray that was executed
top_class_direction_diagnostic.source: frozen RunResult.direction_error_deg = circular absolute error of RunResult.predicted_direction_deg (ensemble top class / top_direction_deg)

jin_2021_style_proxy.executed_control_direction_definition: circular absolute error between frozen RunResult.control_direction_deg (the direction actually executed by direct-first) and RunResult.true_direction_deg

top_class_direction_diagnostic.role: diagnostic only; this is not the direct-first ray that was executed
top_class_direction_diagnostic.source: frozen RunResult.direction_error_deg = circular absolute error of RunResult.predicted_direction_deg (ensemble top class / top_direction_deg)

task_layer.operational_direction_scope: Fresh strict-48 executed-control distribution: circular absolute error of frozen RunResult.control_direction_deg against RunResult.true_direction_deg on the same noisy paired direct-first poses. This is the direction actually used by the controller and is distinct from the structured P1v6 direction stress set.
task_layer.top_class_direction_diagnostic_scope: Frozen RunResult.direction_error_deg measures predicted_direction_deg (ensemble top class / top_direction_deg) against true_direction_deg. It is retained inside each method only as a non-operational diagnostic.
